tools.name: get_me
tools.description: The account this key acts as, and the key itself. Requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Public templates, newest or most popular first; or your own with mine=true. Public reads work without an API key; mine=true requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: One template in one language: tiers, the first 500 items, counts, consensus badges. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: list_template_items
tools.description: A page of a template’s items in position order; follow nextCursor. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: get_template_consensus
tools.description: What people think: per item, the tier most chose, a mean score and how contested it is. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: query_tier_consensus
tools.description: Search public templates by topic and return their community consensus ranking grouped by tier (with item labels, scores, controversy, and MyTierList links) in one call. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: render_text_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a shareable PNG tier list image from plain text tiers and items in one pass (no images, no API key, no account pollution). Cached by content hash with a minimal mytierlist.net watermark; pass inlineImage=true to also receive the PNG inline. Public read-only — works without an API ke

tools.name: render_template_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a shareable PNG tier list image using an existing public template’s images and your tier placements (no API key, no saved result pollution). Cached by content hash with a minimal mytierlist.net watermark; pass inlineImage=true to also receive the PNG inline. Public read-only — works

tools.name: render_custom_tier_list
tools.description: Instantly render a PNG tier list mixing public https:// imageUrl items and plain text items (no API key). Failed or SSRF-blocked image URLs degrade gracefully into text tiles and are reported in failedImages. Returns the PNG directly as an inline MCP image (never hosted publicly in R2). Public read-

tools.name: create_template
tools.description: Create a template. Each item takes an imageId, an imageUrl to fetch, or a text-only label (auto-rendered into a PNG tile). Public unless visibility says private. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: create_text_tier_list
tools.description: One-shot image-free tier list builder: renders crisp PNG text tiles for every item, creates the template, saves your ranked tier list, and returns direct share-card PNG and interactive edit URLs. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Change one of your templates: name, description, tags, tiers, items (by imageId), visibility; draft:false publishes. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: put_template_translations
tools.description: Official names for items in other languages (kept over machine translation, never overwritten by the job), and the title and description per locale (kept until the source text changes). Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: fork_template
tools.description: Copy a template you can read into one of your own. Private unless visibility says public. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: Saved lists, newest first: public ones, optionally for one template; or your own with mine=true. Public reads work without an API key; mine=true requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: One saved list: its tiers as they were, which item went where, the image behind each item, and the share-card URLs. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: get_result_image
tools.description: The share-card URL for a saved list, and whether the PNG is already cached. orientation=landscape|portrait, style=board|poster (board is the default: the page's own board), plus the board fields (layout/gap/corners/divider/align). Does not draw. Public read-only — works without an API key.

tools.name: create_result
tools.description: Save a list for a template: which item goes in which tier. With id, update your own. Requires a free API key with write scope (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: What your keys did over the last days, per day and operation. Requires a free API key (https://mytierlist.net/me/api).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: render_custom_tier_list, create_text_tier_list, get_result, get_result_image · Private data: get_me, list_templates, get_template, list_template_items, get_template_consensus, query_tier_consensus, render_text_tier_list, render_template_tier_list, render_custom_tier_list, create_template, create_text_tier_list, update_template, put_template_translations, fork_template, list_results, get_result, get_result_image, create_result, get_usage · Public sink: create_text_tier_list, get_result, get_result_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: render_custom_tier_list, create_text_tier_list, get_result, get_result_image · Private data: get_me, list_templates, get_template, list_template_items, get_template_consensus, query_tier_consensus, render_text_tier_list, render_template_tier_list, render_custom_tier_list, create_template, create_text_tier_list, update_template, put_template_translations, fork_template, list_results, get_result, get_result_image, create_result, get_usage · Public sink: create_text_tier_list, get_result, get_result_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
